chapter: Down in St. Bernard and the uncle
title: What bands his uncle played in and his instruments
summary: Nelson says his uncle played with Punch, Sam Morgan and Guy Kelly, switching between banjo, guitar, trombone and alto horn, and preferred guitar; he never learned electric guitar.
